paper_id: Variational Multi-Modal Hypergraph Attention Network for Multi-Modal Relation Extraction
title: Variational Multi-Modal Hypergraph Attention Network for Multi-Modal Relation Extraction
motivation: Multiple entity pairs in one sentence share same context (text+image) but require different relations, and existing MMRE methods cannot distinguish them
problem_framing: MMRE must capture high-order correlations among entity pairs, images, and objects for each unique pair
key_insight: Hypergraph structure naturally captures multi-way correlations beyond pairwise; variational Gaussian modeling handles entity/relation ambiguity
method_signature: VM-HAN constructs multi-modal hypergraph with global/intra/inter-modal hyperedges, uses V-HAN with variational attention in Gaussian space
evaluation_criteria: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 on MNRE and MORE benchmark datasets
evidence_for_taste: Existing methods are limited by their neglect
overlook the multiple entity pairs in one sentence
thinking_moves: Identifies structural deficiency in prior work: pairwise modeling insufficient
Maps real-world complexity (multiple pairs per context) to graph-theoretic requirement (high-order edges)
Transfers hypergraph from 3D vision domain to MMRE, hypothesizing high-order structure captures cross-modal correlations
Uses variational framework to convert node uncertainty into learnable representations
Ablates each component to verify contribution of hypergraph structure vs. variational modeling
